scope: Every literal module/CGSCC/function/loop/loopnest pass registration in llvm/lib/Passes/PassRegistry.def; not machine-code passes, out-of-tree plugins or all possible parameter/pipeline expansions.
evidence: Registry inventory and catalog obligation mapping only. Not semantic implementation audits, executable pass contracts or verified pass proofs. Extension/runtime families require their named external contracts.

scalar-algebra.description: Local algebra, casts, comparisons and reassociation
obligations: Respect exact width/flags/undef correlations and use-site context; reassociation needs actual numeric permissions.
scalar-algebra.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

constant-range-propagation.description: Constant, range, predicate, alignment and address-space facts
obligations: Sound transfer and feasible-edge facts; no unknown-to-zero conversion; inferred promises hold at each attachment point.
constant-range-propagation.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

value-numbering.description: Value numbering and redundant computation/load elimination
obligations: Equivalent memory versions and valid dependence facts; replacement dominates; nondeterministic outcomes and call effects remain compatible.
value-numbering.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

cfg-rewrite.description: Branch/PHI, edge, block and region transformations
obligations: Preserve edge-selected PHI values, observable paths, termination, blockaddress/callbr constraints and communicating instances.
cfg-rewrite.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

dead-code.description: Dead instruction, control and loop elimination
obligations: Establish unobservability and appropriate progress assumptions; deleting an infinite effect-free loop still needs a termination contract.
dead-code.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

memory-opt.description: Store/load, copy, initialization and memory motion
obligations: Use byte-range overlap, lifetime and complete clobber facts; preserve volatile/atomic behavior and memcpy/memmove definedness.
memory-opt.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Preserve path-dependent/uninitialized values, byte offsets/padding, escapes and lifetimes; parameter promotion also preserves ABI and new-path access safety.
storage-representation.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

loop-structure.description: Loop canonicalization, rotation and loop-closed SSA
obligations: Preserve zero-trip behavior, exit values, all exits and analysis scopes; rebuild loop/dominance facts.
loop-structure.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Justify newly executed states and changed multiplicity; no unguarded division/load UB or added divergence, effects or communication changes.
loop-motion.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

loop-event-rewrite.description: Unrolling, fusion/fission, interchange, flattening and versioning
obligations: Account for complete event domains, tails/multiple exits and guard partitions; preserve all scalar/control/memory dependencies and values.
loop-event-rewrite.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Scope-nowrap/range facts and count widths; recurrence lifting and exit comparisons must match modular IR arithmetic.
loop-induction.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Use an outcome/representation argument when events are aggregated; establish intrinsic or libcall length, overlap, byte and target contracts.
loop-idioms.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

vector-transforms.description: Loop/SLP vectorization, lane combination, scalarization and interleaving
obligations: Respect runtime scalable width, masks/EVL/tails, inactive poison/undef/passthrough, active memory lanes, reduction order and alias runtime guards.
vector-transforms.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Respect NaN/infinity/signed-zero/rounding/exception/errno contracts and symbol preemption; library availability is target-specific.
fp-and-libcalls.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Preserve call arguments/results, stack freshness/lifetime, normal/unwind/deopt continuations, recursion, bundles and symbol identity; extraction can intentionally change the selected program contract.
inline-outline.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

call-and-tail.description: Call signatures, indirect-call promotion and tail recursion
obligations: Preserve ABI, calling conventions, musttail constraints, stack-observable behavior, fallback dispatch and external callers.
call-and-tail.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

attribute-inference.description: Interprocedural attributes and externally supplied attribute policies
obligations: Inference needs universal scoped evidence; forceattrs and externally imposed policies need an explicit caller-supplied truth contract.
attribute-inference.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

globals-linkage.description: Globals, symbol resolution, LTO, merging and devirtualization
obligations: Account for interposition/ODR/COMDAT/used roots/address identity, external aliases/callbacks and ABI; renaming/internalizing requires the declared link environment.
globals-linkage.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Preserve allowed executions, RMW indivisibility, success/failure orderings and scope; lower-atomic requires an explicit non-preemptible/single-thread environment, not generic concurrent equivalence.
atomic-lowering.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Match the selected personality/target ABI, cleanup/funclet and continuation semantics; lower-invoke uses an explicit unwindless contract.
exception-lowering.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

coroutine-lowering.description: Coroutine frame, split, elision and cleanup
obligations: Preserve frame escape/lifetime, suspension/resumption/destruction protocol, promises, allocation and exceptional paths under the chosen coroutine ABI.
coroutine-lowering.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

gc-runtime.description: Garbage-collection roots, safepoints, statepoints and relocation
obligations: Preserve live root/derived-pointer identity across relocation, collector protocol and stack-map state; dropping relocates requires the exact lowering phase contract.
gc-runtime.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Instantiate the target and intrinsic/runtime semantics; preserve arithmetic, layouts, matrix/lane correspondence, initialization and calling convention. Cost models and target legality are separate from correctness.
runtime-lowering.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Retain deopt state/continuations and widened-condition definedness; removing checks or allow-check operations needs their documented policy and admitted-input contract.
guard-deopt.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

instrumentation.description: Sanitizer, tracing, coverage, profiling and instrumentation lowering
obligations: Separate projection of internal events from requested public diagnostics/profile outputs; justify helper runtime safety, counter atomicity, initialization and valid-input behavior.
instrumentation.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Specify violation diagnostics, helper ABI, protected metadata/layout and admitted valid behavior; security enforcement is an additional property, not ordinary equality on all executions.
security-instrumentation.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

parallel-runtime.description: OpenMP, parallel runtime and accelerator boundary transforms
obligations: Bind the actual parallel/runtime/target specification, thread/team and allocation semantics; do not infer correctness from sequential effects or these generic interfaces alone.
parallel-runtime.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Retain ownership/autorelease/weak-reference/exception and object-lifetime invariants from the external Objective-C runtime contract.
objc-runtime.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

target-extension.description: Target dialect/ABI extensions in the core registry
obligations: Bind the external DXIL/kernel ABI specification and exact intrinsic/metadata semantics; generic model compilation does not establish target conformance.
target-extension.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Respect target intrinsic definedness, address-space/provenance and new-path operands; profitability/profile hints do not justify semantic changes.
prefetch-layout.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

metadata-debug.description: Metadata, naming, debug and embedding policies
obligations: Choose whether debug/symbol/embedded artifacts are observations; retain semantic metadata, operand bundles and externally visible identities unless the policy explicitly changes them.
metadata-debug.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Expand the actual target/options-dependent pipeline; compose only compatible intermediate contracts and update/invalidate analyses after each mutation.
pipeline.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

obligations: Validate recomputed facts against the current IR and dependency state.
analysis-maintenance.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.

diagnostic-tools.description: Evaluation, examples, diagnostics and intentional failure tests
obligations: Retain tooling expectations; deliberate crash/error entries are negative-test utilities, not optimizing transforms.
diagnostic-tools.evidence: Catalog obligation mapping; no concrete pass proof or implementation audit asserted.
